# AI Science Tracker

> A catalog of 5356 entries about scientific results enabled by AI across 12 fields and 2607 organizations since 2020. Each entry links to an original paper, preprint or institutional announcement. Entry counts are not counts of independent findings: methodological contributions can overlap other entries, and one entry can describe several related results. Figures are reported by the sources and are not independently verified; relevance scores are coarse editorial judgments, not evidence grades.

Content is licensed CC BY 4.0 (attribute "AI Science Tracker" with a link); site code is MIT. Epoch AI model data is CC BY 4.0. The separate SWE-bench selection (data/swe-bench.json) is CC BY-NC 4.0, for noncommercial reuse only; it is not covered by the catalog CC BY 4.0 grant. Additional numerical benchmarks (data/benchmarks/) retain per-component CC BY 4.0, CC BY-SA 4.0, MIT or Apache-2.0 terms; see docs/public-benchmarks.md. CharXiv adapted data is CC BY-SA 4.0. These components are excluded from the blanket catalog license and catalog Hugging Face export. When citing a scientific claim, cite the original source linked on each entry, not this catalog.

## Browse
- [Discoveries](https://aisciencetracker.org/): filters, charts and the full list
- [Organizations and model families](https://aisciencetracker.org/profiles/index.html): static profile pages
- [Model progress](https://aisciencetracker.org/model-progress.html): exact model comparison, ECI, benchmark evidence and recorded release rhythm
- [Search all collections](https://aisciencetracker.org/search.html): literal retrieval with separate counts and match reasons
- [Insights](https://aisciencetracker.org/insights.html): the whole catalog in plain-language charts
- [Evidence dossiers](https://aisciencetracker.org/dossiers.html): selected studies and public vulnerability disclosures with evidence limits
- [Open problems to claim](https://aisciencetracker.org/claims.html): next steps left by catalog discoveries, each decided by a public checker
- [Antibiotic evidence dossier](https://aisciencetracker.org/antibiotic-dossier.html): dated, source-bounded synthesis
- [Catalog coverage and evidence](https://aisciencetracker.org/profiles/catalog-evidence.html): reproducible composition tables, counting limits and CSV
- [Static AI-found security cases](https://aisciencetracker.org/profiles/security-index.html): source-attributed case pages readable without JavaScript
- [Models](https://aisciencetracker.org/models.html): model releases linked to discoveries
- [Vuln discoveries](https://aisciencetracker.org/security.html): publicly disclosed vulnerabilities with documented AI involvement, kept separate from the scientific count
- [Methodology](https://aisciencetracker.org/methodology.html): what is included, how entries are verified and scored

## Browse without JavaScript
- By field: [astronomy (92)](https://aisciencetracker.org/profiles/field-astronomy.html), [biology (870)](https://aisciencetracker.org/profiles/field-biology.html), [chemistry (244)](https://aisciencetracker.org/profiles/field-chemistry.html), [climate (106)](https://aisciencetracker.org/profiles/field-climate.html), [computer science (372)](https://aisciencetracker.org/profiles/field-computer-science.html), [humanities (42)](https://aisciencetracker.org/profiles/field-humanities.html), [materials (357)](https://aisciencetracker.org/profiles/field-materials.html), [mathematics (69)](https://aisciencetracker.org/profiles/field-mathematics.html), [medicine (2831)](https://aisciencetracker.org/profiles/field-medicine.html), [multidisciplinary (125)](https://aisciencetracker.org/profiles/field-multidisciplinary.html), [other (66)](https://aisciencetracker.org/profiles/field-other.html), [physics (182)](https://aisciencetracker.org/profiles/field-physics.html)
- By year: [2026 (1865)](https://aisciencetracker.org/profiles/year-2026.html), [2025 (836)](https://aisciencetracker.org/profiles/year-2025.html), [2024 (712)](https://aisciencetracker.org/profiles/year-2024.html), [2023 (592)](https://aisciencetracker.org/profiles/year-2023.html), [2022 (505)](https://aisciencetracker.org/profiles/year-2022.html), [2021 (487)](https://aisciencetracker.org/profiles/year-2021.html), [2020 (359)](https://aisciencetracker.org/profiles/year-2020.html)

## Small JSON for agents
- [latest.json](https://aisciencetracker.org/api/v1/latest.json): the 100 most recently added entries
- [doi-index.json](https://aisciencetracker.org/api/v1/doi-index.json): DOI to entry ID, to check whether a paper is in the catalog
- One file per field at https://aisciencetracker.org/api/v1/fields/FIELD.json and per publication year at https://aisciencetracker.org/api/v1/years/YEAR.json (names in the API index)
- One full record at https://aisciencetracker.org/api/v1/discoveries/ID.json

## Data
- [discoveries.json](https://aisciencetracker.org/data/discoveries.json): active catalog entries, several megabytes ([schema and counting unit](https://aisciencetracker.org/docs/discovery-schema.md), [JSON Schema](https://aisciencetracker.org/schema/discoveries.schema.json))
- [models.json](https://aisciencetracker.org/data/models.json): model releases and families
- [model-progress.json](https://aisciencetracker.org/data/model-progress.json): separate Epoch capability/benchmark source entries; may overlap releases
- [Independent benchmark directory](https://aisciencetracker.org/data/benchmarks/index.json): 11 separately licensed numerical snapshots; source-specific selections and limits
- [vulnerabilities.json](https://aisciencetracker.org/data/vulnerabilities.json): vulnerability cases ([schema](https://aisciencetracker.org/docs/vulnerability-schema.md), [JSON Schema](https://aisciencetracker.org/schema/vulnerabilities.schema.json))
- [sitemap.xml](https://aisciencetracker.org/sitemap.xml): every static page
- [dataset.html](https://aisciencetracker.org/dataset.html): downloads (JSON, CSV), schemas and the read-only static API at https://aisciencetracker.org/api/v1/index.json
- [contributors.html](https://aisciencetracker.org/contributors.html): maintainer, contributors and how to contribute
- [feed.xml](https://aisciencetracker.org/feed.xml): Atom feed of discovery additions and vulnerability source checks
- Each discovery has its own page at https://aisciencetracker.org/share/ID.html
- [llms-full.txt](https://aisciencetracker.org/llms-full.txt): every entry as plain text (ID, title, dates, field, organization, evidence type, summary, source), several megabytes

## For agents
- MCP server (Streamable HTTP, read-only, no token): https://mcp.aisciencetracker.org/mcp with tools search_discoveries, get_discovery, list_fields, search_vulnerabilities and get_vulnerability; Server Card at https://mcp.aisciencetracker.org/mcp/server-card, AI Catalog at https://aisciencetracker.org/.well-known/ai-catalog.json
- [OpenAPI description](https://aisciencetracker.org/api/v1/openapi.json) of the static JSON API

## Notes
- Most recent catalog addition: 2026-11-27. This is not a last-review date.
- The collection is manual and not exhaustive; most sources are the announcing organizations' own pages.
- Repository: https://github.com/marcello-pichini/ai-science-tracker
